question: What is the meaning of disassembly in relation to material recovery information?
description: Disassembly in relation to material recovery information refers to the selective method of deconstruction aimed at minimizing damage to components or materials that are valuable for reclamation and reuse in another building. Controlled disassembly requires more time and resources compared to traditional demolition, but it can lead to financial benefits through the sale of reclaimed materials and components, as well as a reduction in landfill costs.
